_comment: Tier-2 for febio::polar_fluid#0. Three name observations: <var type="micro_rotation"/> reads SUCCESS and then aborts with 'FATAL ERROR: Output variable "micro_rotation" is not defined'; <bc type="zero micro-rotation"> is a parse error; and the micro-rotation DOFs cannot be logged at all — <node_data data="gvx"/> is refused with '"gvx" is not a valid field variable name', so "read the field" means reading the .xplt, not a CSV. Plus the measured caveat: deleting the wall BC moves the logged element data by far less than a solution change would, so a quiet result is not evidence the BC is right. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'polar_micro_rotation_names=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
